name: DiligenceSquared
long_description:
DiligenceSquared delivers AI-powered market due diligence for investment decisions - like the $500k McKinsey reports, but automated, auditable, and at a fraction of the cost.

When Private Equity funds evaluate deals, they pay firms like McKinsey, BCG, and Bain $500K-$1M for market due diligence. The process takes weeks, and the output is a static PowerPoint that's impossible to audit. A single large-cap PE fund can spend >$30M annually on this and the total market is $10B per year.

Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights with every claim linked to source transcripts. No black box, no "trust me" slides, and no 10x mark-up for human labor.

Frederik bought these reports as a Principal at Blackstone. Soren sold them as a Principal at BCG. Harshil is a repeat founder and former Software Engineer at Google. We've seen both sides and know what matters in due diligence - and now we automate it.

Our clients already include 8 leading private equity funds with over $2.4 trillion in combined AUM.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Frederik is the CEO and Co-founder of DiligenceSquared.

Before DiligenceSquared, Frederik was a Principal in Blackstone's Private Equity team across San Francisco, New York, and London, doing multi-billion dollar buyout deals. He was a key decision-maker on the buy-side of commercial due diligence projects, commissioning dozens of $500K+ reports from firms like McKinsey and BCG. He knows what makes diligence credible to investors - and where traditional consulting wastes time and money.

founders.title: Founder/President
founders.founder_bio:
Soren is the COO and Co-founder of DiligenceSquared. 

Before DiligenceSquared, Soren was a Principal at BCG's Private Equity team in New York, focusing on commercial due diligence for some of the world's largest private equity, growth equity, and hedge funds. He led 40+ commercial due diligence projects and knows the workflows intricately - what insights investors actually need and how AI can deliver them faster and better.

launches.tagline: Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights into fully auditable reports – replacing the $500K+ due diligence work from McKinsey, BCG, and Bain.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're Frederik, Soren, and Harshil – co-founders of DiligenceSquared.

**TL;DR**

[DiligenceSquared ](https://diligencesquared.com/)automates **market due diligence for private equity funds**. Our AI agents conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights into fully auditable reports – replacing the $500K+ due diligence work from McKinsey, BCG, and Bain.

We have deep expertise from senior industry positions at **Blackstone, BCG and Google**. Frederik bought this research at Blackstone, and Soren sold it at BCG.

Our clients already include **two of the world's five largest PE funds** and several mid-market funds demonstrating the broad appeal of our technology.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to private equity funds, hedge funds or private credit funds that need credible market intelligence? Contact us at [founders@diligencesquared.com](mailto:founders@diligencesquared.com)

https://youtu.be/DwNAEVXpv8c?si=qIkt0KSTylIdBg4T

**❌ The Problem**

Private equity funds spend **>$10B annually** on commercial due diligence. A standard engagement:

* **Costs $500K-$1M** per project
* **Takes 2-4 weeks** to deliver
* **Relies on junior Associates** often only 1-2 years out of university
* **Provides zero transparency** – no way to trace PowerPoint conclusions back to underlying evidence

The result: Funds delay diligence until the last minute because it's too expensive to do early or skip it entirely on smaller deals. In increasingly competitive capital markets, this creates a real disadvantage.

**✅ Our Solution**

Our AI agents autonomously conduct expert interviews and synthesize insights with **every claim linked directly to source transcripts**. The advantages are significant:

* **Speed & Scale**: Parallel process interviews in local language and instantly synthesize insights with AI.
* **Transparency and depth**: Trace any insight back to its underlying source, such as exact quote in interview transcripts. No black box, no "trust me" slides.
* **Cost**: Fraction of traditional fees—making diligence economical for deals that couldn't justify it before.

As one Managing Director at a PE fund told us: _"80% of the insight at 5% of the cost. It's a no-brainer for early-stage Commercial Due Diligence."_

**🤝 The Team**

Our team has spent years in private equity, consulting, and tech. We know what great due diligence looks like and how to automate it.

* **Frederik** was a Principal at Blackstone's Private Equity team across London, NYC, and San Francisco. He spent 6 years buying these $500K+ reports and knows exactly what investors find valuable versus unnecessary bloat.
* **Soren** was a Principal at BCG in NYC and spent 7 years leading commercial due diligence projects for the world's largest funds. He knows exactly which process and analytical steps can be automated.
* **Harshil** was a Software Engineer at Google, leading AI systems in Google Ads. He's a repeat founder with 10 years of experience building production ML systems and knows how to operationalize them at scale.

**🙏 Our Ask**

**Can you introduce us to:**

* Private Equity, Growth Equity, Private Credit, and Hedge Funds
* Portfolio companies or corporates that need market intelligence
* Deal professionals frustrated with traditional market due diligence

👉**Contact us at [founders@diligencesquared.com](mailto:founders@diligencesquared.com)** or visit [**www.diligencesquared.com**](http://www.diligencesquared.com)
